Quick on the Draw.name: Quick on the Draw
Quick on the Draw.description:
⏱️ You react first: to a threat, a question or an opening, sometimes before you know what you are reacting to.

🌱 In a sudden fight or emergency you act at the first opening, and you are first to move when a blow comes.
⚠️ You jump at false alarms, commit before seeing a feint and sometimes act on the wrong target.
⚠️ Opponents who notice can bait an early move, and waiting for a signal takes effort.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Dodging +5
Quick on the Draw.traitNarrativeEffects: The character reacts fast: first to move when a blow comes, first to answer, first to catch a falling object or reach for a phone. In a sudden fight or emergency the narrator lets them act at the first opening. Weakness: speed comes before full information. They jump at false alarms, answer before the question ends, commit to a move before seeing the feint and sometimes act on the wrong target. Opponents who notice can bait an early move. Waiting for a signal takes effort, and others may find them impatient or rude. The narrator may show the itch to move first; the player decides whether the character commits or holds.
